modules.text:
Potential Energy, usually shortened to PE, is the quiet current behind this craft. A [[PE Statue|guide_statues]] makes it; a [[Pedestal or Collector|guide_pe_machines]] receives it; relays carry it onward. PE is stored by the machine, not printed into chat. A little patience is part of the apparatus.

Start with a [[Monolith Stone|guide_monolith]]. Deepslate bricks and a Shadow Gem make a useful first anchor.
